content: This flowchart provides a detailed strategy for mitigating cardiovascular risk in individuals aged 18 years or older who have type 2 diabetes (T2D) and at least one of the following conditions: atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD), heart failure (HF), diabetic kidney disease (DKD), or a high risk of developing ASCVD. The approach emphasizes the simultaneous management of multiple factors to optimize patient outcomes.
